title: Flottila folder.yaml, schemaVersion 1 (draft — review at hand-over, P2-02a, D-078)
description: Describes the folder it lies in, any folder below the package root (never the root itself): an optional namespace, kept verbatim (no trim, no case fold) and unique within the package, and an optional description. The folder's artifacts are found by their kind, not by this file.

namespace.description: e.g. the XML namespace of the messages the folder's flows handle; compared byte for byte.
